plugins.name: hilbana
plugins.description: Everything Hilbana in one install: persistent agent memory (an engram replacement, with hooks that load context and save summaries automatically) + the human+agent workflow framework (pull queue and the cycle commands /hilbana-claim-next, /hilbana-finish, /hilbana-plan, /hilbana-review) + Hilbana's MCP server auto-registered. Commands and skills are written in Spanish.
